subject.title: [Feature]: Catch up on missed inbound messages after gateway restart

question: Should OpenClaw add a core cross-channel inbound catch-up/replay contract after gateway restart, and what default/config policy should providers follow?
rationale: The issue is valid but not a narrow bug fix: Slack, Discord, Telegram, iMessage, and other transports have different history, ack, idempotency, scope, and rate-limit contracts, and the requested config surface changes existing operator behavior.

options.title: Define a provider-owned catch-up contract
options.body: Add a core/plugin seam for restart catch-up and require each provider implementation to prove gating, idempotency, rate limits, and upgrade-safe config behavior.

options.title: Keep fixes provider-specific
options.body: Continue landing targeted recovery work for iMessage, Telegram, followup queues, and individual Slack/Discord gaps without committing to one cross-channel contract yet.

options.title: Decline generic catch-up
options.body: Document that only transports with durable replay support recover missed offline messages and leave other channels to user or plugin tooling.

recommendation.title: Define a provider-owned catch-up contract
recommendation.body: Add a core/plugin seam for restart catch-up and require each provider implementation to prove gating, idempotency, rate limits, and upgrade-safe config behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history ties the central channel/gateway recovery surfaces to steipete, and the decision needs core/plugin boundary judgment.
